row.evidence: Typeform's Enterprise page lists "SOC2/HIPAA compliance, secure SSO/SCIM provisioning", and the pricing page marks Single Sign-On (SSO) as Enterprise only.
row.notes: Still gated on Enterprise (Contact sales). Plans billed yearly are now Basic $28/mo (1 user), Plus $56/mo (3 users), Business $91/mo (5 users), Growth Flow $266/mo, Enterprise custom; June listed Basic at $29 and Growth Essentials/Pro, which no longer appear. Team plan moved from Basic to Plus because Basic is single-user. SCIM is named only on the Enterprise marketing page: no public SCIM docs, and the Okta OIN app is SWA only. Help centre says SSO is included only in Tier 1 Enterprise and is extra on other Enterprise plans. API has no org-member endpoints, only workspace membership.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Single-user plan, so not the team plan.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Help centre says SSO is only included in the Tier 1 Enterprise plan and is an extra cost on other Enterprise plans. Org activity log is a CSV emailed from Admin settings, not an API.

limitations.text: Typeform publishes no SCIM documentation (base URL, auth, endpoints or attributes); SCIM is only named on the Enterprise marketing page. SSO setup itself is done with Typeform's Customer Success Manager.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieve basic information about the authenticated account
Update a workspace, including add/remove members by email with a role

audit_log_api.notes: Org activity log (Enterprise or Growth Custom) is requested in Admin settings and delivered as an emailed CSV; no API documented.

rate_limits.text: Create and Responses APIs: two requests per second per Typeform account.

limitations.text: The developer reference (Create, Responses, Webhooks, Embed) has no organisation-member endpoints; only workspace membership can be changed via PATCH /workspaces/{workspace_id}.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SWA as checked (SAML, OIDC, SCIM and all provisioning capabilities unchecked). Typeform's help centre instead has customers build a custom SAML/OIDC app in Okta.

onelogin.notes: Typeform's SSO article names OneLogin as a supported SAML/OIDC IdP but documents no OneLogin connector.
